Description:
Seramic Materials Ltd. is a UAE-based company born out of the innovative ecosystem at Masdar Institute/Khalifa University and established in the Masdar City Free Zone in June 2019 supported by The Catalyst, a Masdar-BP initiative and MBRIF. We specialize in developing unique circular economy solutions that recycle solid industrial waste into sustainable, value-added products for the technical ceramics and construction markets. By replacing raw materials with locally sourced waste, we offer several key advantages:
	1.	Cost Reduction: Waste is significantly more affordable than conventional raw materials, resulting in a 10-50% reduction in product costs, depending on the application.
	2.	Sustainability: By avoiding the extraction and transport of natural resources, we reduce carbon emissions, leading to a product with at least 30% less CO2 compared to conventional ceramics.
	3.	Energy Efficiency: The energy required to process waste-based ceramics is lower than traditional methods, resulting in a 20% reduction in energy consumption.
	4.	Waste Diversion: Our process reduces the amount of industrial waste sent to landfills, contributing to a more sustainable waste management system.

Seramic’s approach is backed by over $2 million invested in R&D over the past decade, 27 scientific publications, and 6 patents. Our proof of concept has been validated through extensive testing of various waste mixtures and the development of innovative products and methods. To bring this technology to market, we’ve built the first laboratory in the GCC dedicated to transforming industrial waste into value-added products at Masdar Tech Park. This facility will support the development of a near-zero-waste industrial approach, contributing to a more sustainable future.

#SustainableInnovation #CircularEconomy #WasteToValue #GreenTech #Sustainability #IndustrialInnovation

Name: Taweelah B Power & Desalination Complex
Description:
The Taweelah B Independent Water and Power Project is the fifth and the largest IWPP developed in Abu Dhabi under the Government’s highly successful programme aimed towards privatisation of the water and power sector. The Taweelah B Power & Desalination Complex is comprised of three distinct power generation and desalination facilities, each operating under a different technology: Initial B Plant (IB), Initial B Extension (IBE) and New B Extension (NBE).

►Initial B Plant (IB): Comprises of six units being made up of a steam raising boiler, a condensing steam turbine generator, with steam extraction to a multi-stage-flash seawater desalination distiller.
►Initial B Extension (IBE): comprises of two gas turbines each exhausting into a heat recovery steam generator raising steam to drive a back-pressure steam turbine generator which, in turn, supplies steam to three multi-stage-flash seawater desalination distillers.
►New B Extension (NBE): comprises of three gas turbines operating in combined cycle mode exhausting into a heat recovery steam generator raising steam to drive a back-pressure steam turbine generator which, then feeds the steam into the four multi stage flash seawater desalination distillers.

Guided by the core values of ►Integrity, ►Professional Work Ethic, ►Flexible Approach, ►Team Spirit, ►Fair & Consisted Dealings, ►Self-Motivation, ►Consciousness and putting ►Health & Safety first, our aim is to become the pioneers in Power Production, Water Production, Health & Safety Excellence, and Environmental Stewardship in the UAE and therefore fuel Emiratisation.

This publication is a condensed set of Sougata Nandi’s personal real life anecdotes that maps his evolution as an Energy Manager, through the actual implementation of over 200 clean technology projects in the UAE over 20 years. These anecdotes will reinforce the fundamentals of energy management and de-clutter the misconceptions around jargon like ESCO, Energy Audits, M&V, IPMVP, degree-days etc. While the anecdotes lean heavily towards energy management in real estate, the principles outlined can be seamlessly applied to any industry.

Bioware ME was established by a team of friends who strongly believe in the anti-plastic movement and want to  help reduce the detrimental environmental impact that the world is currently being engulfed in.
Founded in 2019 Bioware provides products that are total game changers biodegradable food packaging and hospitality products made from renewable sources.

What are we?

The technology used in BioWare’s products are 100% renewable made from plants to produce alternatives to plastic products. Our products are made of natural plants such as the sugarcane (bagasse), paper, bamboo and bioactive thermoplastic aliphatic polyester (PLA). 

While there have been many alternatives to plastic over the last two decades, they have not been economical for the everyday user to make the switch to. In recent years technology has enabled to come up with more economical solutions to which BioWare now distributes in the MENA region.

Our future

Our goal is to drive the agenda for change and to bring awareness that there are alternatives to plastic and to replace them with bio-plastics. We have firmly joined the #saynotoplastic movement and move ahead to helping the environment before government and legislation changes.
There has been an increase in the awareness in the region through a few campaigns of the impact of the use of single use plastic and while major corporations have been making small changes, Bioware aims to be accessible to everyone. We have been seeing the changes in plastic consumption legislation in the west and east and hope that UAE and the rest of the MENA region are to follow.

We are ready to offer the MENA region accessibility to 100% biodegradable alternative products towards most damaging items to our environment.
